title: Whistle stop tour of Barcelona 😃
text: Amazing! Very informative guide and a good way to see more of Barcelona I would definitely recommend this trip we were on limited time as only stopping off from a cruise ship. They also gave us instructions how to get to their office which was very helpful  thanks to our guide !
author: karen_s

title: It was an enjoyable three...
text: It was an enjoyable three hour tour. Our guide Michael was informative and offered to stop and take our photo in multiple locations. One of the best ways to see the city.
author: Kristen_H

title: Excellent way to get a taste of Barcelona
text: Ellie was a wonderful entertaining  guide. Amusing and very knowledgeable Great way to see the city in a short period of time .
author: Juanita_C
